description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Developement - Notify the Approval for the Amendment of Planning & Building Regulations 2008-2020 of Sri Jayawardenapura-Kotte MC
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the approval and amendment of planning and building regulations for a municipal council area under the Urban Development Authority Law. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving legal frameworks and compliance requirements, specifically falling under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory modifications rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
